description: This file defines the CollateralCannotBeDeletedException class, which is a custom exception used in the collateral module of the Fineract project. It includes an inner enum to specify reasons why collateral cannot be deleted, and a constructor to instantiate the exception with specific context.

classes.name: CollateralCannotBeDeletedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a collateral cannot be deleted, with reasons specified by the inner enum.

methods.name: CollateralCannotBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor that creates the exception with a specific reason, loan ID, and collateral ID.
